paths.scope: Rigid modeled boxes/carrier only. Prewired leads and solder fillets not modeled; no continuous-path or full harness acceptance.

sourceSupportComparison.meaning: Provenance comparison only. Do not replace the already modeled/printed integrated support in this baseline restoration.

manufacturerEvidence.retention: Existing insert uses insulating edge liner and ties. The supplier module is a solder-pad board, no plug-body CAD or installed lead shape is represented.
manufacturerEvidence.thermal: Manufacturer back thermal pad is intended to couple to copper heat spreading; this local fit does not validate loaded thermal performance.

retentionGeometry.bandSource: Existing design specified two4.8mm bands, not a newly invented clamp. Actual tie position must avoid components and pads.

assembly: Wire and insulate the module while the insert is off robot and both module faces are accessible.
Seat board in loose insert; no converter mounting screws required.
Offer wired insert from negativeX into the original battery bay, before rear IMU cover/cable closure; use existing two band stations.
Keep soldered lead exits and the rear thermal surface open. Do not show invented seated USB/JST plugs on this solder-pad module.

priorEvidence.scope: Historical source trajectory and then-current scene, retained evidence only; not rerun/rebranded as current full robot motion acceptance.

connectorBoundary: Existing8x26x30box is full published module size; populated details/soldered wire exit not native CAD. Exact solder-pad coordinates and wire attachment side are not established by a box. Bench prewiring avoids an in-situ solder-tool access claim.
